annotations.title: Create a Meta custom audience or lookalike

description: Build a retargeting audience on a connected Meta ad account. Four kinds: kind:"website" (people whose visited URL contains urlContains, seen by pixelId — pass the brand’s own domain for "all visitors"; retentionDays up to 180), kind:"engagement" (people who did `event` on the brand’s Facebook Page, or its Instagram business profile with source:"instagram"; retentionDays up to 730), or kind:"lookalike" (sourceAudienceId + country + ratio 0.01–0.20 = the top 1%–20% most similar people, lookalikeType "similarity" or "reach", or startingRatio for a band such as 1%–3%). Meta delivers a lookalike to the locations of the AD SET that targets it, so `country` is where you will run it — target the same country in that ad set. CREATING AN AUDIENCE SPENDS NOTHING — it is a definition; money only moves when an ad set targets it and that campaign is activated through set_meta_campaign_status(confirm:true). Meta needs roughly 30 minutes and ~1,000 people before a new audience can be targeted, so a fresh one reporting no size is normal. kind:"customerfile" is the brand's OWN CUSTOMER LIST (emails, phones, names…) for retargeting, suppression or as a lookalike seed: pass customerFileSource (a required attestation of where the data came from: USER_PROVIDED_ONLY, PARTNER_PROVIDED_ONLY or BOTH_USER_AND_PARTNER_PROVIDED), plus schema (the column names in order, from EMAIL, PHONE, FN, LN, FI, CT, ST, ZIP, COUNTRY, DOB, DOBY, GEN, MADID, EXTERN_ID) and rows (arrays in that order, up to 10,000 per call) to upload them in the same call. Hermoso normalizes and SHA-256-hashes every value before it leaves the server, exactly as Meta requires, and reports Meta’s own match counts (a mostly-rejected upload is a format problem and says so). To ADD more people to an existing list, call again with kind:"customerfile" + audienceId + schema + rows (uploads add, they never replace). Meta asks the ad account to accept its Custom Audience Terms once; if it has not, Meta’s refusal says so.

audienceId.description: customerfile: ADD these rows to this existing customer-list audience (from list_meta_audiences) instead of creating a new one

country.description: lookalike: REQUIRED 2-letter country you will run it in — Meta delivers a lookalike to the locations of the ad set that targets it, so target this country there

customerFileSource.description: customerfile: REQUIRED attestation of where the list came from (customers gave it to you = USER_PROVIDED_ONLY)

description.description: optional free-text note stored with the audience

event.description: engagement: page_engaged | page_visited | page_liked | page_messaged | page_cta_clicked | page_or_post_save | page_post_interaction — or ig_business_profile_all | ig_business_profile_engaged | ig_user_messaged_business | ig_business_profile_visit

kind.description: which kind of audience to build — customerfile = your own customer list

lookalikeType.description: lookalike: similarity (tighter) or reach (broader) — default similarity

name.description: audience name (required unless adding rows to an existing list with audienceId)

pageId.description: engagement: which connected Page (required only if the profile has several)

pixelId.description: website: the Meta Pixel that sees the traffic

prefill.description: website/engagement: seed it with activity from BEFORE the audience existed (default true)

ratio.description: lookalike: 0.01–0.20 = the top 1%–20% most similar people (default 0.01)

retentionDays.description: how long someone stays in it — website max 180, engagement max 730 (default 30)

rows.description: customerfile: the customers, one array per person in schema order (up to 10,000 per call). Plain values — Hermoso normalizes and hashes them before they leave the server

schema.description: customerfile: the column names of rows, in order, e.g. ["EMAIL","PHONE"]

source.description: engagement: Facebook Page (default) or the linked Instagram business profile

sourceAudienceId.description: lookalike: the existing audience to model (from list_meta_audiences)

startingRatio.description: lookalike: optional lower bound for a band (e.g. 0.01 with ratio 0.03 = the 1%–3% band) — at least 0.01 and less than ratio; not combinable with lookalikeType

urlContains.description: website: the URL fragment that defines the audience (your domain = all visitors)
